objective: Remover fisicamente os frontends legados após a Fase 2A comprovar ausência de consumidores operacionais.

removal.strategy: git-tree deletion of both legacy directories in one atomic commit

rollback.strategy: restore only the removed directories on a recovery branch; do not rewrite main history

guardrails: CI fails if frontend-angular or frontend-vuetify reappears physically.
CI fails if an operational workflow, root package, Playwright config or quality script references a legacy frontend.
Historical documentation may retain references because it is non-executable evidence.
done_criteria: Both legacy directories are absent from the branch tree.
CI Enterprise Fast, full CI, evidence and governed merge gates are green before merge.
